summary: Danaher Corp (DE) filed a preliminary prospectus supplement (424B5) offering four series of senior notes (floating rate and three fixed-rate tranches) to fund a portion of the cash consideration for its proposed acquisition of Masimo Corp (Masimo Acquisition). The notes are not contingent on closing; if the merger is not consummated by Nov 16, 2026 (Outside Date), or the agreement is terminated earlier, Danaher must redeem the fixed-rate notes at 101% of principal plus accrued interest (special mandatory redemption). The floating-rate notes are not redeemable before maturity except for tax law changes. Danaher may also redeem fixed-rate notes at any time at specified prices, and a change-of-control triggering event would require an offer to repurchase all notes. Proceeds will support the acquisition; listing on NYSE is sought. Risk-arbitrage angle: watch for regulatory clearance and Masimo shareholder approval timelines; special mandatory redemption mechanism caps downside for noteholders if the deal fails.
